summary: REQ-43 appears implemented via PricingPage navigation with URL search params and BillingPage reading tier/period to compute exact amount from pricingCopy with safe defaults. UPI deep-link construction for exact amount and plan note is present, but the diff is truncated before showing whether best-effort deep-link failure detection/toast guidance remains. The auto-upgrade flow (backend payment request creation tied to selected plan+amount and auto-approval within ~60s) is not clearly implemented in the shown backend/frontend code; migration adds only a planId field to payment requests and initializes plan/userPlan maps, but expected amount/tier/period and auto-approval logic are not evidenced. Backend plan persistence/query hook and planStore syncing is partially evidenced in AppLayout, but the backend query and hook implementation are not shown in the provided excerpt.

Backend changes shown do not evidence an upgrade-intent creation endpoint, expected-amount/tier/period fields, or auto-approval timer/logic that upgrades user plan after ~60s.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a query to fetch caller’s current plan tier and billing period, updates stored plan on auto-approval; frontend adds a React Query hook in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts and syncs planStore from backend plan query results.
